openings.claim: Pencil assigned pattern and exact quantities on envelopes; retain tags/samples and mark quantities after filling. This combines quantity guidance, ongoing checking and exterior assignment identification.
openings.discriminator: Matched local loose materials eliminating omissions while correctly used shared-tray checklists retain them defeats quantity confusion as the central explanation.
openings.probe: Alternate matched batches: incumbent, shared trays plus envelope checks, local loose materials without checks. Independently audit contents; count omissions, crossing reaches and preparation/filling/checking time. Then test 60-kit performance.
openings.uncertainty: O4's mixture is unknown; checklist overhead, supply depletion and full-run transfer remain untested. Exact quantities must be recoverable from samples.

openings.claim: On an existing tally sheet, bind each sample component to tray-tag colour, required quantity and dimensions; mark after envelope insertion. This explicit binding differs from independent tags and samples.
openings.discriminator: Linked cues must outperform equally consulted unlinked cues and exceed summed single-parent improvements versus neither cue; otherwise consultation or additive effects suffice.
openings.probe: Compare matched batches: neither cue, tags alone, samples alone, linked cues, equally consulted unlinked cues. Record picking versus filling errors and elapsed time; excessive handling time defeats usefulness.
openings.uncertainty: Accurate samples, matchable assignments and legible mapping space are assumed. Neither interaction benefit nor workshop success is observed.

lineage.reason: Preserves envelope guidance, assignment visibility and interference rival.
Preserves explicit binding and interaction/attention controls.

decision: Probe both distinct hypotheses. Every arrangement must preserve assigned quantities/dimensions, use exactly two volunteers, existing envelopes/supplies and the 180-by-75-centimetre table, with all preparation and checking within 90 minutes. Success requires 60 complete assigned kits and at most one distribution correction; small batches cannot establish it. Synthetic evidence leaves error location, opened-packet footprint and reserve-supply handling unresolved.
